draft.emotion: steady, rhythmic, and purposeful, as if moving toward a comfortable destination
notes: Godan (u) verb. Takes the particle を (o) to mark the place or path one walks along (e.g., 町を歩く, 'to walk through town'), and まで (made) or に/へ (ni/e) for the destination.
Often used in the te-form 歩いて (aruite) to mean 'on foot' (e.g., 歩いて行く, 'to go on foot').

draftBefore.emotion: steady, rhythmic, and purposeful, as if moving toward a comfortable destination
notes: 歩く (aruku) is the general verb for walking. It focuses on the movement itself rather than the destination.
Unlike verbs of arrival or departure, 歩く describes the act of moving on foot, whether for exercise, commuting, or just getting from one room to another.
